scope: Final local Next.js production build, with an explicitly marked disposable PostgreSQL database and a local-only administrator account.
command: FINFLO_BLOG_E2E=1 FINFLO_BLOG_TEST_STATE=/tmp/finflo-editor-test-state.json TEST_INDEXABLE=true TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 npx playwright test tests/e2e/blog-admin.spec.ts tests/e2e/blog-editor.spec.ts --reporter=line --output=/tmp/finflo-editor-functional-results
verified: Private draft creation using the visual editor; exact existing Markdown survives reload and opening visual/source views without becoming dirty.
Optimistic concurrency rejects stale edits, private previews stay protected, and drafts/archives remain unavailable to anonymous visitors and absent from the sitemap.
Publish, save published changes, unpublish, archive, restore, republish with the original publication date, and sign out.
Bold, italic, strikethrough, heading levels, lists, checklists, quotes, code blocks, undo, redo, Markdown source and the shared safe reader preview.
Ctrl/Cmd+K opens only article link settings; a valid inserted link remains a link in both the editable document and reader preview.
Unsafe link/image URLs and images without alternative text are rejected; a valid image with alternative text renders correctly.

Tables insert and add rows/columns; unsupported block formatting stays disabled in cells while inline formatting remains available; multiline cell breaks and a paragraph after the table survive reader preview.
Malicious imported Markdown and pasted HTML cannot insert script/event handlers, unsafe embeds or active link/image URLs into the editor or reader preview.
Title, publishing actions and the editable surface remain inactive until JavaScript hydration completes.

Footnotes remain intact in source mode with a read-only visual surface and correct reader preview; removing them re-enables visual editing; plain Markdown footnote pastes are rejected without losing existing content.
At 360 by 844 pixels in both light and dark themes: one page H1, no horizontal document overflow, keyboard-operable Finflo formatting dropdown/buttons, and zero axe violations within main.
limitations: These are local production-build checks, not a claim that the new source is deployed to finflo.org.
Accessibility scans cover the tested admin main surface in both themes, not every possible document or browser.
Visual editing intentionally stays read-only for footnote documents; Markdown source remains available to preserve them.
